# Widget Co. Product Catalog (Excerpt)

This is a fictional internal document used as a local test fixture. Like
`sample.md`, its facts are invented — here specifically to stress-test
exact-term matching (product codes, SKUs) that sparse/BM25 retrieval
handles well but dense embeddings often don't represent precisely.

## SKU-4471-B — Widget Deluxe Model X

The Widget Deluxe Model X (SKU-4471-B) is Widget Co.'s flagship consumer
unit. It ships with a 3-year warranty, draws 45 watts at peak load, and
retails for $189.99. Replacement parts for this model use the prefix
`WDX-`.

## SKU-2205-A — Widget Compact Model S

The Widget Compact Model S (SKU-2205-A) is the entry-level unit. It draws
12 watts at peak load, ships with a 1-year warranty, and retails for
$49.99. It does not support the WDX replacement-parts line; its parts use
the prefix `WCS-`.

## SKU-8830-C — Widget Pro Model Z

The Widget Pro Model Z (SKU-8830-C) is the commercial/industrial unit. It
draws 220 watts at peak load, ships with a 5-year warranty, and retails
for $1,249.00. It requires a dedicated 20-amp circuit for installation.

## Discontinued: SKU-1002-A

SKU-1002-A (Widget Original Model, 2018–2021) was discontinued in 2021
and is no longer eligible for warranty service.
